name: UltraEdit
description: UltraEdit is a large-scale dataset of approximately 4 million instruction-based image editing samples, generated automatically to provide diverse, high-quality editing instructions and real image anchors for fine-grained image editing tasks.
reputation: A large synthetic instruction-editing dataset that is useful for training and evaluating fine-grained image editing models, though it is more often used as a data resource than a standardized leaderboard benchmark.
notes: Dataset leverages LLMs and human raters for instruction diversity and includes real images and region annotations.
